scenes.say: Ever wonder why Snowflake queries are so quick? Let's break down the pieces that make it fly.

scenes.label: Warehouse
scenes.sub: Virtual warehouses are clusters you can scale or pause anytime.
scenes.say: First up, virtual warehouses. They're clusters you can scale up or pause to control both speed and cost.
Next, Snowflake stores your data in micro-partitions. These are tiny, unchangeable chunks that make reads fast and storage efficient. Snowflake can skip scanning chunks you don't need.

scenes.title: Clustering Example
scenes.say: Clustering lets you organize data by columns you filter on a lot. For example, clustering sales by customer ID speeds up those queries.

scenes.question: How do you control Snowflake costs?
scenes.right: Resize or pause warehouses, and use clustering to scan less data.
scenes.say: Here's a common interview trap. Cost control isn't just about deleting data. You can resize or pause warehouses, and use clustering to scan less data and save money.
